description: Overseer guard, free and local: at session start, lists the files that steer Claude Code in the project (CLAUDE.md files, agents, skills, commands, settings, MCP servers, the scripts hooks run) and points out, once, what needs a look, such as a hook that runs code or a reviewer pinned to a weaker model; it rescans when one of them changes during the session. And when Claude writes a file that looks like instructions for an AI model, it notes that /overseer:check can check it. They spend nothing and never block; OVERSEER_GUARD=off turns guard off, and OVERSEER_HOOK=off turns off both.
